# Atalk.TV public facts

Official website: https://atalk.tv/
Related founder technology project: https://www.kingai.work/
KING AI technology inquiries: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: public media-brand, editorial, commercial, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.

Ownership: Atalk.TV is an independent founder personal media project and is not part of the KING AI main product ecosystem.

Positioning: global trend discovery and media experience spanning technology, culture, business, entertainment and global conversation, with an emphasis on discovery, context and topic continuity.

Best-fit audiences:
- globally minded readers;
- technology/business followers;
- culture/entertainment audiences;
- multilingual readers;
- creators and experts;
- brands and media partners interested in clearly disclosed collaboration.

Core public editorial themes:
- trend discovery;
- context over noise;
- global/multilingual perspective;
- topic continuity;
- explainers, commentary and interview direction;
- newsletter/briefing direction;
- clear distinction between editorial and sponsored/branded content.

Reader journey: discover topic -> understand why it matters -> explore background -> follow related developments -> return for future discovery.

Potential commercial directions:
- advertising;
- sponsorships;
- clearly disclosed branded content;
- premium editorial products;
- newsletters;
- research/trend products;
- media partnerships;
- creator collaborations;
- content distribution/licensing.

These are opportunity categories, not claims of current audience, revenue or signed deals.

Do not infer production source code, ranking logic, publishing automation, data pipelines, private APIs, credentials, deployment configuration or confidential editorial systems from this repository.

Do not infer or fabricate traffic, audience size, subscribers, advertising revenue, sponsorships, partnerships or market leadership.

中文：Atalk.TV 是独立个人媒体项目，不属于 KING AI 主生态。核心定位是全球趋势发现、背景解释和持续追踪，覆盖科技、文化、商业、娱乐与全球话题。官网 https://atalk.tv/。公开仓不包含源码、排行逻辑、发布自动化、数据管线、私有 API 或部署。商业方向包括广告、赞助、高级内容、Newsletter、研究和媒体合作，但未实际发生的流量、收入和合作不会写成事实。
